names: The LTM-quarters check's cause of an EBITDA DIFFER names a figure it could not read (EBIT, or the Cash Flow's Depreciation & Amort., Total) and why, in the export's words, where it printed Python's None; the $0 refresh of that cause (ltm_quarters_transform) is a no-op on a page that already carries one, and rewrites a cause in older words, where it refused as more than the cause moving
